html:
Aeonic is a very simple text-based adventure. No real gameplay. You just go through slides representing eras of history, each of slides with text and an illustration. The idea of the game is to explore what if you could play through whole of the history, from the earliest ages to the future, through all of the eras, at least significant ones.

Read the text, look at the images, and pick from the couple of choices you have to get different outcomes for each era, while you progress. You can also get several endings.

Please note that we used generative artificial intelligence as a tool for creating the illustrations and some of the text, so it helped us bring the project and its stories which we thought of to life, noting the scope of the idea that we tried to represent and assemble to explore in this very simple text game form. It is basically more of an interactive book, than a game.

If you want to appreciate this project try to think about its idea when playing - what if you could go from the beginning of history to nowadays and even the future, through all eras, in one game or even a gameplay loop.
